note: Concession-run (Signal Mountain Lodge) campground on Fonda Point at the north end of Jackson Lake, in spruce and fir forest, 8 mi N of Colter Bay and 11 mi S of Yellowstone's South Entrance. Generators are allowed only in the first loop (sites 48-63), 8am-8pm. Narrow loop roads; check each site's pad length before booking. --Claude
summary: Concessionaire + rec.gov + NPS data: 60 sites (27 walk-in tent), RV/trailer max 25 ft (stored 30) and only 4 RV sites take 23 ft+, $53 + tax 2026-2028 (NPS data $49), flush toilets (stored vault), water, no showers/dump/hookups, reservation-only, 14 nights, Senior/Access discount, season Jun 11-Sep 12 2027. Pin ~470 m N of the campground centre -> move. Lakeview lead for loop 2's shore sites.
flags: FIT (criteria, keep with caveat): the concessionaire and rec.gov cap trailers/RVs at 25 ft and per-site pads run 15-25 ft; only sites 21 (25), 22 (23), 36 (25) and 57 (25) take a 23-ft rig, out of 33 RV sites. The NPS data still says RVs 30 ft / trailers 20 ft. Stored max_rig_ft 30 -> 25.

PIN MOVE (~470 m): stored 44.00740,-110.68680 is north of both loops (~280 m beyond loop 1, sites 48-63, and ~680 m from loop 2). Suggested 44.0034,-110.6887 (the NPS campground point, between the two loops; catalog site centroid ~44.0032,-110.6888).

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored 'not waterfront'; lakeview candidate): NPS says 'The campsites are in a spruce and fir forest on the shores of Jackson Lake'. On imagery loop 2's south edge sites 32 (44.00172,-110.69137), 34, 35, 36 (25 ft) and 37 sit ~15-45 m from the vegetated high-water edge with only scattered trees/shrubs, but the loop road runs between every one of them and the shore (and Jackson Lake's drawdown beach beyond), so on-water is out; a lakeview needs the view confirmed in the rec.gov site photos, which I did not open. Loop 1 (generator loop, 48-63) is ~300 m inland.
